title: Simple Oven-baked Chicken, Broccoli & Rice
ingredients: 1 head of broccoli (~200g), broken into florets
steps: In a large ovenproof dish, mix chicken with dried parsley, garlic granules, onion granules and seasoning. Spray with cooking spray; mix in rice.
Pour hot stock over rice; ensure everything is submerged; cover tightly with foil.
Bake on middle shelf for 30 minutes.
Remove; fluff up rice with a fork; scatter broccoli florets over top in a single layer.
Replace foil; bake for further 15 minutes until stock is absorbed, rice is fluffy and broccoli is steamed.
notes: Jazz up with peas, green beans, cauliflower or asparagus. Add finely grated lemon zest and juice for more flavour.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
